fields.Name: T259 - Feature Pipelines List and Search
fields.Description: Exercises the feature-pipeline card list + client-side search (SearchQuery/FilteredPipelines) with its status-aware Run buttons — a bespoke card grid distinct from other KH surfaces.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Feature Pipelines' in the left nav (fa-diagram-project icon). Success is that the pipelines screen renders as a card grid (each card showing target entity, output attribute, last-run status, and Run/Edit buttons) OR a clear empty-state inviting you to create a pipeline. Then type into the 'Search by name, entity, or attribute…' box and confirm the card grid narrows to matching pipelines (or shows a 'No matching pipelines' state). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Feature Pipelines screen renders a pipeline card grid OR a valid 'No feature pipelines yet' empty state
Typing in the search box narrows the cards to matches OR shows a 'No matching pipelines' no-results state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
